query: SELECT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "user" INNER JOIN workspace_user ON workspace_user.user_id = "user".id WHERE "user".email = $1::CITEXT AND workspace_user.workspace_id = $2) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "user" INNER JOIN workspace ON workspace.super_admin_id = "user".id WHERE "user".email = $1::CITEXT AND workspace.id = $2)) AS "already_member!: bool";
